yunbeiuc.gui.sidebar.title: Patterns & Fonts
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_basic.desc: Mainly organizes commonly used pattern resources together, such as directional arrows
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_background.de: Integrates multiple base images that need to be assembled, making it convenient to pair with other patterns
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_tourist.desc: Used to guide people to nearby tourist areas, identify directions and distances to tourist areas, and understand types of tourist projects. Tourist area signs are divided into tourist guide signs and tourist symbol signs.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_notice.desc: Used to remind drivers of situations that require attention during driving or driving behaviors to avoid, including behaviors prohibited by relevant laws and regulations. Traffic safety reminder signs may use graphical representations.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_assist_others: Auxiliary signs should be installed below the main sign, close to the lower edge of the main sign.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_warning.desc: Warning signs warn vehicle drivers to pay attention to situations ahead that are difficult to discover and require slowing down or taking other safety actions.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_no.desc: Prohibition signs indicate prohibition, restriction, and corresponding cancellation meanings. Road users must strictly comply.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_indication.de: Indication signs indicate the meaning of directing vehicles and pedestrians. Road users should comply.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_guide.desc: Guide signs indicate road information guidance, providing drivers with information about roads to their destination, relevant towns along the way, important public facilities, service facilities, locations, distances, and driving directions. Guide signs should not direct private or commercial destination information.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_guide_general: General road signs use blue as the background color, white for text and patterns. General road guide signs are mainly used for urban roads, county roads, township roads, village roads, and other general roads.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_guide_directi: Used to inform about the form of the intersection ahead, the number or name of the intersecting road, the direction to go, the direction of travel, and other information.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_guide_express: Urban expressway and expressway signs use green as the background color, white for text and patterns. Urban expressway and expressway guide signs are mainly used for urban expressways and expressways.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.sign_guide_facilit: Provides road users with identification and direction to various important places, set at appropriate positions in front of the identified place.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.custom_patterns.de: Read through JSON configuration files in resource packs. For custom pattern creation guides, please refer to the mod help documentation.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.custom_fonts.desc: Read through JSON configuration files in resource packs. For custom font creation guides, please refer to the mod help documentation.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.builtin_fonts.desc: The following are fonts provided by Yunbeiuc, which can be referenced in the -json command through the "font" field.

yunbeiuc.gui.homepage.title: Yunbei UC · Patterns & Fonts
yunbeiuc.gui.homepage.welcome: Welcome to the Yunbei Urban Construction Patterns & Fonts Selection Interface
yunbeiuc.gui.homepage.intro.p1: Yunbei Urban Construction (YunbeiUrbanConstruction) is a city construction mod focused on restoring urban traffic infrastructure. It integrates road blocks, road signs, municipal facilities, traffic equipment, and practical tools, all restored according to reality. The mod includes a complete text editing system and custom sign system, allowing players to freely arrange text, icons, and patterns in the sign editing interface.
yunbeiuc.gui.homepage.intro.p2: This interface is the built-in pattern and font selector of Yunbei Urban Construction, used to quickly insert images and fonts into text lines. All patterns come from the mod's built-in road sign textures and are written into text lines as -texture commands after insertion; fonts are written as -json commands and can be freely combined with colors, bold, and other styles.
yunbeiuc.gui.homepage.intro.p3: In addition to built-in patterns, this interface also supports reading player custom resource packs: place JSON configurations and images in the correct format into a resource pack, and they will be visible and usable in the "Player Custom Resource Pack" category. For creation guides, please refer to the mod help documentation.
